note: Launch of Futures of Maths, an anonymous online platform where research mathematicians rate short statements about mathematics and AI and propose their own; it is open to those with at least one article in the last five years in a zbMATH Open-indexed journal, checked mainly via ORCID on a separate site, and the authors plan to publish the results once enough responses arrive.
title: Futures of Maths Launch
who: Francesco Fournier-Facio, Yara Kyrychenko, Jon Roozenbeek and Julian Wykowski (guest post on Terence Tao's blog; cross-posted from Proofs and Prompts)
